summary: Regression testing completed: backend public/protected API tests passed 4/4 and unauthenticated browser flows passed for dashboard, chat, favorite, booking, OAuth failure, search, and profile.

integration_issues.issue: Favorite buttons on PhotographerCard still only toggle local React state and do not call /api/favorites; profile favorite is correctly wired.

action_items: Wire search/home PhotographerCard favorite buttons to /api/favorites or clearly disable them for unauthenticated users.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotographerCard has a local-only favorite implementation, creating inconsistent persistence versus the profile favorite flow.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ photographer registration was created by the existing regression test; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unauthenticated regression flows pass. Positive OAuth/customer session and authenticated booking/chat persistence remain untested because no credentials/session are available. Payment remains intentionally DEFERRED/MOCKED.
rca of the issue: Profile actions use backend fetches, but the reusable PhotographerCard favorite handler still calls only setFav and toast, so cards can claim a favorite without persistence.
